query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tobacco_cannabis_accord_recettes (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  accord_id INT NOT NULL,
  recette_id INT NOT NULL,
  relation_type VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'inspired_by',
  relevance_score DECIMAL(3,2) DEFAULT 0.80,
  notes TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE KEY unique_accord_recette (accord_id, recette_id)
);
